subject.title: fix(tts): defer text settlement for final-mode TTS to eliminate churn (#83511)

question: Should OpenClaw accept `captionedFinalText` as a public channel capability and make Telegram use captioned final-mode TTS by default once the branch is rebased and proven?
rationale: The patch is a plausible owner-boundary fix for the reported bug, but it expands the plugin/channel contract and changes existing Telegram message-delivery ordering, which automation should not approve as a purely mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Accept after rebase and proof
options.body: Keep the capability-gated design, require conflict resolution and current-head Telegram proof, then let maintainer review decide final merge readiness.

options.title: Require an explicit delivery mode
options.body: Ask the author to preserve existing separate text-plus-voice behavior unless users or channels opt into captioned final delivery through a maintainer-approved mode.

options.title: Pause this branch
options.body: Pause or close this PR if maintainers do not want a new public channel capability/default behavior change in core right now.

recommendation.title: Accept after rebase and proof
recommendation.body: Keep the capability-gated design, require conflict resolution and current-head Telegram proof, then let maintainer review decide final merge readiness.

likelyOwner.reason: The relevant reply dispatch and routed-delivery history plus public channel capability decision point make this the best available owner route.
